tasha: Quick note /audit/privileged-logs is sending mixed signals: says "90 days default" but also "customer-managed TTL". Ruby snippet shows old method.
maria: can you paste the lines? i'll open a PR.
tasha: retention line: "We retain privileged audit logs for 90 days by default; customers can configure TTL via the API." ruby shows `client.audit.export`.
kevin: suggest: "Tenant-configurable retention period (default: 90 days). Exports supported for audits. Redwood staff access requires documented emergency approval." clear for SOC2.
maria: i'll update text, fix Ruby+Python+cURL examples to use `/v1/audit/export` and `audit_export` method name, and add a compact JSONL sample demonstrating pseudonymized user IDs.
docs-bot: running link-check for /audit/**.
docs-bot: link-check finished  found 1 broken link: /sdk/ruby/audit_export (404).
maria: will add redirect and update PR.
sophia-legal: quick look  prefer "tenant-configurable retention period" and add link to internal emergency-access playbook. approve after that.
maria: updated per legal, PR opened and preview deployed. merging after CI.
tasha: thanks all, this should cut down support tickets.
